title: Neelambari
desc: Vinod and his TV channel crew arrive in a village for a crucial assignment. A series of spooky events is set in motion after they interview a mysterious woman who lives there.

title: Chellata
desc: In order to secure money for his sister's dowry, Ganesh invests his money in a business, only to lose it. During this process, a rich woman falls in love with him, unaware of his financial condition.

title: Duniya
desc: Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.

title: Bell Bottom
desc: The son of a police constable and an aspiring detective, Divakara begins to investigate a robbery at the police station. However, this leads him to uncover a complex web of secrets.
